left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria(Only patients who fully meet the following criteria are eligible to
participate in the trial):
  -  Meets the diagnostic criteria for sepsis-3 developed by the American Society of Critical Care Medicine (SCCM)/European Critical Care Medicine Association (ESICM)
  -  Age  [AND] ≥18 years old and age ≤80years old

right.raw_text:
-  Procalcitonin ≥2ng/ml
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Age＜ [OR] 18 years, or age＞80 years

left.raw_text:
-  Pregnancy  [OR] or lactating
  -  A solid-organ  [OR] or bone marrow transplant patients

right.raw_text: -  Patients with myocardial infarction within the past 3 months
-  Patients with cardiopulmonary resuscitation before enrollment

left.raw_text: -  blood/ [OR] lymphatic system tumors are not remission

right.raw_text: -  patients with limited care (lack of commitment to full，aggressive life support)

left.raw_text: -  patients with long-term use of immunosuppressive drugs  [OR] or with immunodeficiency
-  patients combined with non-infectious factors leading to the death(uncontrollable major bleeding, [OR]  brain hernia, etc
-  surgically unresolved infection sources(such as some intraperitoneal infection etc
